title: DIGITAL EYE – Laser Scanning Technologies to Support Construction
excerpt: Digital Eye aims to democratize access to point cloud processing software, enabling SMEs to implement this technology that has long existed in the AEC sector, but which lacks widespread adoption due to its cost and technical know-how.
content:
Digital Eye aims to democratize access to point cloud processing software, enabling SMEs to implement this technology that has long existed in the AEC sector, but which lacks widespread adoption due to its cost and technical know-how. oint clouds, acquired through laser scanning or photogrammetry or photogrammetry, have more and more applications in the construction industry, from enabling the monitoring of construction progress and quality to serving as detailed geometric references during BIM modeling of existing existing buildings and infrastructures. Digital Eye therefore aims to develop and implement fully automated solutions based on these increasingly popular assets, with the aim of creating a platform that reduces construction errors and improve the efficiency of existing AEC workflows.

Main Activities

  • Develop a digital platform to support the implementation of DIGITAL EYE on the construction site.
  • Develop AI solutions to automate the point cloud: processing; comparison with 4D BIM models; and generation of BIM models (scan-to-BIM).
